en_title: Max Verstappen Spent 40 Hours Playing GTA 6 and Still Won the Las Vegas Grand Prix
cn_title: Max Verstappen玩了40小时《GTA 6》，仍然赢得拉斯维加斯大奖赛冠军
opus_summary: 赛车手Max Verstappen透露，他在拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末的早晚玩了超过40小时《GTA 6》，并赢得比赛。他还表示自己已完成游戏80%的剧情，但跳过了大部分主要过场动画。

paragraphs.en: Famous Dutch-Belgian race driver Max Verstappen revealed that he’d spent the weekend of the Las Vegas Grand Prix locked in to GTA 6, saying he played over 40 hours of the game.
paragraphs.cn: 著名荷兰裔比利时赛车手Max Verstappen透露，他在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的周末沉迷于《GTA 6》，玩了超过40个小时。

paragraphs.en: Everyone’s got GTA 6 fever, including Max Verstappen. Not even the Las Vegas Grand Prix could stop him from causing virtual chaos in Vice City, which he says he spent more than 40 hours doing during the weekend of the race.
paragraphs.cn: 人人都为《GTA 6》着迷，Max Verstappen也不例外。就连拉斯维加斯大奖赛也没能阻止他在罪恶都市的虚拟世界里制造混乱，他说自己在比赛周末花了超过40个小时这么做。

paragraphs.en: Verstappen nonchalantly dropped this nugget of information during a live stream the following week, saying he would play the game in the mornings and evenings in between his duties on the track.
paragraphs.cn: Verstappen在下一周的一场直播中若无其事地透露了这件事，称他会在赛道上的工作间隙，早晚玩这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: “I played a lot in the evening and in the morning in Vegas,” Verstappen explained. “I mean, I can’t go out anyways and walk around.”
paragraphs.cn: Verstappen解释道：「我在拉斯维加斯的晚上和早上玩了很久。我的意思是，反正我也不能出门四处走走。」

paragraphs.en: The driver also revealed that he’s been so focused on GTA 6 and driving real-life race cars that he’s “completely forgotten” how to play Minecraft, despite having a scheduled stream for it.
paragraphs.cn: 这位车手还透露，他一直太专注于《GTA 6》和驾驶现实中的赛车，以至于「完全忘了」怎么玩《我的世界》，尽管他已经安排了一场直播玩这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: “I’m so bad when I play too many games at the same time. I can’t, I just can’t!” he joked.
paragraphs.cn: 他开玩笑说：「我同时玩太多游戏的时候表现就很差。我不行，我就是做不到！」

paragraphs.en: 🤯Max Verstappen played GTA VI for FORTY HOURS while in Las Vegas
paragraphs.cn: 🤯Max Verstappen在拉斯维加斯期间玩了四十小时《GTA VI》

paragraphs.en: On top of that, he also won the race https://t.co/jwuxQnHxyS
paragraphs.cn: 除此之外，他还赢得了比赛https://t.co/jwuxQnHxyS

paragraphs.en: The Las Vegas Grand Prix took place on November 19 - 21. Verstappen took first place in the prestigious Formula 1 race, beating out Britain’s Lando Norris and Australia’s Oscar Piastri. The race is around 50 laps long with a total race distance of 192.6 miles (309.96 kilometers), generally lasting around one and a half hours.
paragraphs.cn: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛于11月19日至21日举行。Verstappen在这场备受瞩目的一级方程式赛事中击败英国车手Lando Norris和澳大利亚车手Oscar Piastri，夺得第一名。比赛全程约50圈，总距离为192.6英里（309.96公里），通常持续约一个半小时。

paragraphs.en: As revealed by the name, Grand Theft Auto is a game series that involves a lot of vehicles, and not just for carjacking; the latest entry in the franchise even features drag racing and mudding, a hobby common in the American countryside that involves the use of off-road vehicles racing through mud-covered areas or even specially-made racetracks.
paragraphs.cn: 正如名称所示，《侠盗猎车手》是一个涉及大量载具的游戏系列，而且不只是用来劫车；该系列的最新作品甚至包含直线加速赛和泥地越野，后者是美国乡村常见的一项爱好，参与者驾驶越野车辆驶过泥泞地带，甚至在专门修建的赛道上竞速。

paragraphs.en: It’s quite likely that Verstappen dabbled a bit in these side missions, though he says that he’s already beaten 80% of GTA 6’s story. In fact, the driver admitted that he has skipped most of the main cutscenes, calling them “too boring.”
paragraphs.cn: Verstappen很可能稍微玩过这些支线任务，不过他说自己已经完成了《GTA 6》80%的剧情。事实上，这位车手承认自己跳过了大部分主要过场动画，称它们「太无聊了」。

paragraphs.en: Verstappen’s style of playing GTA 6 is one of several that we’ve seen over the weekend. In fact, many players are avoiding progressing the story in favor of spending time in Chapter 1, which sees Jason living the average life of a drug runner in Rockstar’s fictionalized version of the Florida Keys. Oddly, it’s a slow-paced, slice-of-life section of the game that some players haven’t left yet, preferring to take it easy diving for treasure, fishing with Cal, and soaking up the environment.
paragraphs.cn: Verstappen玩《GTA 6》的方式，是我们在这个周末看到的几种玩法之一。事实上，许多玩家没有推进剧情，而是选择把时间花在第一章。在这一章中，Jason在Rockstar虚构的Florida Keys过着一名毒品运送者的平凡生活。奇怪的是，这是游戏中一段节奏缓慢、描绘日常生活的内容，但有些玩家至今仍未离开，而是更愿意悠闲地潜水寻宝、与Cal一起钓鱼，并沉浸在周围的环境中。
